definitions: A pair of punctuation marks [ ] used in writing to enclose words or figures so as to separate them from the rest of the text, often to indicate an addition, correction, or explanation by someone other than the original author.
In mathematics, they are used to denote an interval, a matrix, or the integer part of a number.
examples: The editor added an explanation in square brackets.
Please use square brackets for the array notation.
The original text was unclear, so I inserted a clarification in square brackets.
